title: Mitochondrial fission factor senses and governs ferroptosis
title_zh: 线粒体分裂因子感知并调控铁死亡
abstract: Ferroptosis is a form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and is implicated in diverse pathological states1–4. Although mitochondria and other organelles are increasingly being recognized as important modulators of ferroptosis5–7, a unifying mechanism that couples organelle dynamics to ferroptotic execution has remained elusive. Here using quantitative phosphoproteomics, we identified mitochondrial fission factor (MFF) as a key ferroptosis-selective regulator. Mechanistically, the lipid mediator 17-HETE promotes phosphorylation of MFF at Ser155, which triggers the coordinated fragmentation and dysfunction of mitochondria and peroxisomes. This remodelling intensifies interorganelle crosstalk, amplifies oxidative stress and accelerates ferroptotic death. To monitor this phosphorylation event in living cells, we developed MFF–SPARK, a phase-separation-based biosensor, for real-time tracking of ferroptosis through MFF activation. Using MFF–SPARK, we identified PKCβ and DUSP22 as a coordinated kinase–phosphatase pair that governs MFF phosphorylation. We also discovered avermectin B1 as a pharmacological activator of the PKCβ–MFF axis, which can sensitize tumours to ferroptosis in vivo. Together, our findings establish MFF phosphorylation as a central regulatory node in ferroptosis-associated organelle remodelling and provide a conceptual framework and toolbox for monitoring and pharmacologically interrogating ferroptosis. The mitochondrial–peroxisomal fission adaptor MFF is identified as a selective pro-ferroptotic mediator, and the newly developed MFF–SPARK sensor enables high-content screening of ferroptosis-sensitizing compounds and the discovery of upstream regulators of MFF.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡是一种由铁依赖性脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡，并与多种病理状态相关1–4。尽管线粒体和其他器官被越来越多地公认为铁死亡的重要调节因子5–7，但尚未阐明将器官elle动力学与铁死亡执行相连接的统一机制。在此，我们利用定量磷酸化组学，将线粒体分裂因子（MFF）确定为关键的铁死亡选择性调节因子。机制上，脂质介质17-HETE促进MFF在Ser155位点的磷酸化，从而触发线粒体和过氧化物体的协调分裂和功能障碍。这种重塑加强了器官elle间串扰，放大了氧化应激并加速铁死亡。为在活细胞中监测这一磷酸化事件，我们开发了MFF–SPARK，一种基于相分离的生物传感器，用于通过MFF激活进行铁死亡的实时追踪。利用MFF–SPARK，我们确定了PKCβ和DUSP22为协调的激酶–磷酸酶对，共同调控MFF磷酸化。我们还发现阿维菌素B1作为PKCβ–MFF轴的药物激动剂，可在体内使肿瘤对铁死亡敏感。总之，我们的研究成果确立了MFF磷酸化在铁死亡相关器官elle重塑中的核心调节节点，并提供了监测和药理学探针铁死亡的概念框架和工具箱。线粒体–过氧化物体分裂适配器MFF被确定为选择性促进铁死亡的介质，新开发的MFF–SPARK传感器可用于铁死亡致敏化合物的高通量筛选以及MFF上游调节因子的发现。
